areas.name: Campaign Completion Audit
areas.location_cue: The campaign and level-selection menus after every map has been visited.
areas.note: Use this final ledger to separate Classic/Revolution completion from later-version extras.

levels.1: Save the hardest standard run until the routes and arenas are familiar.
levels.2: Start a fresh The First Encounter campaign on Serious difficulty and finish every area.
levels.3: Use manual saves before missable secret triggers, clear all fifteen campaign maps on Serious, and retain the final completion record. Difficulty-specific enemy substitutions do not replace the fixed-location checklist.

levels.1: Review each level result rather than relying on memory.
levels.2: Confirm all 83 applicable Classic/Revolution secret records have registered across the campaign.
levels.3: Compare every level's displayed secret total with its checklist. The eleven Xbox- or HD-only records are intentionally reserved for those later installed versions and do not belong in this Classic route.

levels.1: Treat treasure as a separate sweep from the secret counter.
levels.2: Confirm all 93 physical treasure pickups from the fifteen campaign maps.
levels.3: Count split groups as individual objects: paired bags or chests contribute two, while the three-object Metropolis group contributes three. Revisit any map whose Revolution treasure tally is short.

levels.1: Let each encounter fully populate before leaving its arena.
levels.2: Finish each level with its available enemy tally complete on the chosen difficulty.
levels.3: Check the statistics before every transition. Search delayed spawns and secret-triggered encounters, but do not mix totals between difficulties because enemy composition can change.

levels.1: Do not chase counters documented only in another release.
